d:
Why are flight tickets becoming so expensive just ahead of Diwali 2026? As people prepare to travel home for the festive season, airfares on several domestic routes are witnessing a sharp surge, putting an additional burden on passengers.
In this discussion, Tanushree and Prashant break down the sudden rise in flight ticket prices, examine how much airfares have increased compared to regular days, and discuss the possible reasons behind the surge.
